program.merge_policy: accumulate twenty 25-finding passes; consolidate, admit, validate, and merge once after Wave 1000

source_provenance: PubMed systematic reviews/meta-analyses; exact PMID verification and full-history dedupe through Wave 925

policy.validation_strategy: full-history PMID/entity screening during authoring; full repository validation only after Wave 1000

waves.focus: Nine-RCT/545-participant review of supplements for endometriosis-associated pain; pelvic pain, dysmenorrhea and dyspareunia were not significantly improved overall, with trial trustworthiness concerns.
Network meta-analysis of dietary supplements for osteoarthritis; rankings are indirect, product-specific and not evidence of category-wide superiority.
Systematic review/meta-analysis of antioxidant supplementation for dysmenorrhea/endometriosis-related pain; heterogeneous compounds and small trials require intervention-specific interpretation.
Systematic review of 11 RCTs/716 participants; positive dietary/supplement signals are limited by heterogeneous interventions and moderate-to-high risk of bias.
2026 NAFLD/MASLD meta-analysis; ALT and alkaline-phosphatase signals with AST/GGT nulls, preserving disease and surrogate-enzyme boundaries.
2026 network meta-analysis of 14 RCTs/791 adults across vitamins, magnesium, CoQ10, probiotics and combinations; rankings remain exploratory and indirect.
2025 migraine systematic review/meta-analysis; fatty-acid composition, intervention duration and migraine outcomes must remain explicit.
Systematic review/meta-analysis of green-tea interventions for oral/periodontal health; evidence was insufficient for first-line dental use.
2024 systematic review of vitamin C in periodontal/oral health; high heterogeneity across 16 studies/17,853 participants limits uniform clinical claims.
2024 network meta-analysis of probiotics adjunctive to nonsurgical periodontal therapy; strain/product rankings are indirect and outcome-specific.
26-RCT/1,721-participant skin-aging meta-analysis; hydration/elasticity/wrinkle signals coexist with design, publication and funding concerns.
19-trial/1,125-participant skin meta-analysis; hydration/elasticity signals are historical positive evidence with product and trial-quality limitations.
Systematic review/meta-analysis of green tea as an adjunct in periodontal therapy; adjunctive context and local/systemic preparations remain distinct.
Ten-RCT/646-participant collagen-based skin meta-analysis; hydration and elasticity signals with predominantly female samples and moderate heterogeneity.
2024 systematic review of ascorbic acid and periodontal/oral outcomes; dietary exposure, supplementation, periodontal status and biomarker outcomes remain separated.
2025 meta-analysis of 24 studies in gingivitis/periodontitis; effects differed by condition and outcome, and several gingivitis measures were not significantly improved.
Historical 24-RCT adjunctive periodontal meta-analysis; short-term CAL/PPD/BOP signals were not consistently maintained at six months.
2026 systematic review of 25 skin RCTs; efficacy and safety were inconsistent across products, doses, durations and measurement instruments.
2026 umbrella review of 11 oral-health probiotic meta-analyses; inherited methodological quality and strain/outcome heterogeneity prevent a generic oral-health claim.
Historical dementia meta-analysis of nine trials/2,372 participants; cognitive signal with activities-of-daily-living null, retained against newer evidence.
2024 systematic review of 10 oral-chamomile anxiety trials; most trials reported improvement but heterogeneity and limited pooled certainty require caution.
2025 seven-RCT oral hyaluronic-acid meta-analysis; hydration, elasticity and wrinkle-depth signals with firmness, wrinkle-volume and transepidermal-water-loss nulls.
2026 migraine systematic review/dose-response meta-analysis of 12 trials/749 participants; frequency and duration improved with very high heterogeneity; study exposure is not a dosing recommendation.
Twenty-two-trial GRADE meta-analysis across magnesium, CoQ10, riboflavin, ALA, probiotics, vitamin D and omega-3; supplement-specific effects and omega-3 nulls retained.

2026 endometriosis systematic review; non-postoperative pain/NSAID/endometrioma signals contrasted with a postoperative randomized comparison showing no added benefit, while fertility evidence remained preliminary.
